---
title: "About me"
---

Hello World!

I'm Max, an economist, multidisciplinary researcher and data science enthusiast with extensive expertise in labour, housing and energy markets, and population and consumer behaviour. I enjoy devising innovative problem-solving approaches and leading large and complex quantitative projects to deliver actionable insights for decision-making.

I currently work as a data scientist at Informed Decisions (.id), where I drive continuous improvements to .id's population forecast models and tools.

The purpose of this blog is to post brief but robust and insightful economic and population analyses that can be useful or at least interesting to readers.

Nothing posted in this blog is meant to represent .id's position or opinions.
